data.text: KAD-74 measured 2026-10-12, Claude Code 2.1.286 headless, kadence 0.9.1, two fresh partial clones of this repository: arm M with auto memory only (no journal, no hooks, the decision prose removed from CLAUDE.md), arm H with auto memory plus the journal and both hooks. Session 0 in each told the agent the ten decisions and asked it to remember them; auto memory saved them. Then the ten rejected-idea prompts, one fresh read-only session each. Pushed back before proposing: arm M 10 of 10, arm H 10 of 10 — for one person on one machine who has just told the agent, kadence adds nothing to the pushback. The difference is the reason: arm H cited the decision in all ten (9 by DEC-N) and quoted the recorded reason; arm M could check nothing, reconstructed the reason twice and got one wrong (p9). The hook named the right decision on 9 of 10, 6 as rejected-before; p10, embeddings, is the KAD-78 miss. Cost ~$4 per arm. Caveats: one run, one model, memory filled moments before — memory's best case; a teammate on another machine has none of it. So the pitch is the team's: your agent remembers, your teammate's doesn't.
